tools.name: echo
tools.description: Echo the argument blob back inside a JSON envelope.

tools.name: chatty
tools.description: Makes 100 host calls, to price one.

tools.name: typed
tools.description: Deserializes its arguments, to price a JSON parse against `echo`, which carries the same payload without reading it.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Allocates, to prove the heap arrives without a second entry.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Reads one stored key and answers whether it was set. Under `examples/load.rs` the read stands in for a host call that waits on I/O.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches the URL in its arguments and answers the status and the body's length. A second word onward is one `Name: Value` header, which may name `{secret:fixture}`.

tools.name: boom
tools.description: Always fails, to exercise the error path.

tools.name: nest
tools.description: Calls `echo` on whatever is deployed as `inner`, to prove a program can reach a program. Says which kind of failure came back, because telling "it ran and said no" from "it was never there" is the point of the second bit on the wire.

tools.name: tick
tools.description: Counts how many times it has run, arming itself to run again in the milliseconds its arguments name until it has run three times. Proves an invocation can outlive the one that asked for it, and that what crosses the gap is the program's own keys.

tools.name: note
tools.description: Writes its argument under `note`, emits it as a `Noted` event, answers what it reads back, and fails when the argument is `fail`.

tools.name: relay
tools.description: Calls `note` on `inner` with its argument, carries on whether or not that failed, emits under the topic `relay`, and answers what this program reads back under `note`.

tools.name: seen
tools.description: Takes the `Noted` events of `fixture` and keeps the last one's `seq` and word under `seen`.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Calls `peek` on `fixture`, then `echo` on `fixture` with the note it read, and answers what `echo` did.

tools.name: peek
tools.description: Reads `note`, then tries to write it, emit under `note`, arm `tick` and call `note` on `inner`, and answers what it read and what each attempt was told.

tools.name: recurse
tools.description: Calls itself on `inner`, which is this same program when deployed under that name — the runaway a depth limit exists to stop. Reports how many levels got through before the host refused.
